headline: Solemn Judgment
title: Solemn Judgment Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Solemn Judgment. What is it? It is a Counter Trap Card. What does it do? When a monster would be Summoned, or a Spell or Trap is activated, pay half your Life Points to negate it and destroy that card. How do you use it? Save it for the one card that would beat you. It is Limited, so one copy per Deck. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
